newsitem.title: USA: Canon cuts prices on two digital cameras.
newsitem.headline: Canon cuts prices on two digital cameras.

text.p: Canon Computer Systems Inc, a subsidiary of both Canon USA Inc and Canon Inc, said Wednesday it reduced the prices of two of its PowerShot digital cameras.
The PowerShot 600 will sell for an estimated street price of $699 and Canon's PowerShot 350 will sell for an estimated street price of $599.
The PowerShot 600, the company's first entry in the "point-and-shoot" digital camera arena, also has a built-in microphone for voice annotations that can be attached to each photo.
The PowerShot 350 is a pocket-sized camera meant for PC users who want to create picture databases or integrating photos onto a Web site.
